messages:
matt: Heads-up, canary in eu-west started showing 502 spikes after the values merge. deploy-bot reported 15% error rate at 12:02 UTC.

katie: saw that in alerting, digging into the chart values override that landed in the same PR. looks like `payment.timeout` went from 30s -> 5s accidentally.

raj: omg that explains it. 5s will OOM the downstream job. is the canary pinned or do we autoscale?

matt: it's on a small pool. deploy-bot: can you surface the exact deploy that caused this?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2024-06-04T12:00:03Z initiated by katie/gh:PR#4123. Canary fraction 5% -> 20% scaled by rollout policy. Values diff: `payment.timeout: 30 -> 5` and `cache.max_age: 600 -> 60`.

katie: thanks. I can open a hotfix PR to revert timeout to 30, or we can pin the chart version back to previous digest. opinions?

raj: revert values is quicker. pinning chart requires QA and release notes. Hotfix PR + manual canary hold seems safest for now.

matt: agree. we also need to decide whether to trigger automatic rollback by deploy-bot or hold for manual patch. error rate is ~15% but not full outage.

eva: if we rollback automatically we lose the batch of other unrelated fixes in this deploy. prefer hotfix revert. we should also extend the deploy-bot grace window to allow an immediate human patch before rollback.

katie: created PR #4130: revert payment.timeout to 30 and restore cache.max_age to 600. small change. ETA ~8m for CI.

matt: redeploy dry-run when CI passes. deploy-bot: please pause automatic rollback for this canary for 20m (grace period) and notify eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Pausing auto-rollback for deploy 2024-06-04T12:00:03Z for 20 minutes per request from matt. Notifying #eng-oncall.

raj: adding a quick test plan in the PR to assert 200s for /health and no 502s on payment uplink.

katie: CI green, merging #4130. will trigger canary patch. command: ```kubectl -n payments rollout restart deployment/payments-service```

matt: rolling patch initiated. monitoring.

deploy-bot: Canary patch applied at 12:16 UTC. New canary fraction stable at 5% for 5m. Health checks passing.

eva: metric check: error_rate -> 1.2% after patch, latency back to normal.

raj: ok looks good. matt, do you want to unpause auto-rollback or leave it default?

matt: unpause it and resume normal deploy policy. Also add an entry to release notes: "Reverted accidental `payment.timeout` regression causing 502s during canary in eu-west."

katie: adding to release notes and to the changelog draft. Also opening a follow-up to add a schema guard in the helm values linting job to prevent sub-second timeouts.

matt: thx. we should also add `values-stitching` check to deploy preflight to detect multi-pr PR merges that touch chart + values. Ticket next sprint. :thumbsup:
